BEGINNING at the intersection of the Southwesterly line of Redman Avenue (60.00 feet wide) with the  
Southerly line of Turnley Avenue (20.00 feet wide, also known as Veterans Lane); thence

(1)  Along the Southwesterly line of Turnley Avenue, South 44 degrees 49 minutes 50 seconds East, a

(2)  Along said division line, South 45 degrees 00 minutes 00 seconds West, a distance of 100.00 feet to an
